title: Marble Works
pitch: Build a short track from a limited kit, release a marble and guide it into the goal.
capabilities: Static track assembly and reusable materials
Physical testing plus authored construction constraints
rules: Build only while paused. Snap ramps, curves and funnels to a known grid; validate overlaps before committing.
Run releases exactly one marble. Win when it settles in the goal sensor; out-of-bounds or timeout offers retry.
Editing after a run resets the marble to its start. Do not rewind only the renderer while leaving physics advanced.
content: Eight authored puzzles and a bounded free-build mode with six track pieces.

actions.xr: Ray-select kit; place with ray or hand
Rotate buttons or deliberate grab rotation

rive.role: Animated start gate and goal sign; visual parts never substitute for physical collider geometry.

polish: Trajectory replay line after an attempt
Snap preview unmistakably distinct from committed track
Goal uses settling dwell, not one noisy overlap
tests: Fast marble does not tunnel through track seams in qualified speed range.
Edit while running pauses and resets explicitly.
Phone piece rotation works without gesture conflicts.
XR scaling does not change marble gravity or goal radius in model units.
loop: in build mode validate and commit snapped piece placement
on run create/reset marble from level start
step Rapier with selected CCD settings
track goal sensor dwell and out-of-bounds
commit win/fail and show attempt trace
save: Layout plus progress; live run snapshot supported only on same pinned physics build.
xr_presentation: A miniature construction board in AR or on a virtual VR table; construction handles use the same snapping rules as desktop.
comfort: Fixed-table experience; never move the camera along the marble automatically.
documentKind: Layout plus progress; live run snapshot supported only on same pinned physics build.
